package.name: plansys2_aletheia_plan_solver
package.description: Plan solver plugin that runs the Aletheia epistemic planner as an external process, the way plansys2_popf_plan_solver runs POPF. The same planning is available in-process from plansys2_epistemic_planner; this package exists for deployments that keep the planner binary outside the ROS process, and it reuses that package's parser, validator and policy serialisation rather than reimplementing them.
